events.title: Proposed ruling: no_action (model confidence 0.90)
events.body:
This is a rider-side cancellation, so the case enters the NS rules through NS-0: cancelled_by = rider on an immediate (non-advanced) job routes to NS-4 [F2][NS-0]. The trace settles the two NS-4 elements: the rider cancelled 3 min 20 s (200 s) after matching, i.e. more than 3 minutes [F2], so the $6.61 cancellation fee stands and the outcome is no_action [F5][NS-4].

The rider's ground is that the driver "was still far away after more than 3 minutes". That is true on the record — the driver's closest approach to the pickup was 2137 m at 21:32:55 [F1] and the platform never recorded him at the pickup point [F3], with no "I'm Here" tap [F4] — but it is not a ground for a refund under Ryde's published rules. Ryde has no "driver later than ETA → free cancellation" rule (NS-8 is informative only and cannot be cited), and NS-4 states expressly that the driver not having arrived does not make the rider's cancellation free [F1][F3][NS-4]. The rider's remedy is a discretionary human appeal under NS-7, not a refund through this decision [NS-7].

The driver's ability to claim anything against the rider is irrelevant here: the fee on record is a rider-side cancellation fee, and the driver never tapped arrival and was never within range, so no waiting-fee or no-show charge against the rider arises [F3][F4][NS-1][NS-6]. NS-2 likewise does not apply — it concerns a driver cancelling on a no-show claim, and here the rider cancelled [F2][NS-2]. NS-1's conditions (driver pressed "I'm Here", was within 200 m, waited over 3 minutes) all fail on the record, so nothing in either party's brief can move the fee [F1][F3][F4][NS-1].

Safety screen: I read chat #1 ("How long will you be?") [F7], chat #2 (driver: "About 5 min, traffic") [F8], the complete timestamped 2-message record [F9], the driver's post-trip statement ("I was on my way when the rider cancelled") [F10] and the rider's complaint [F2]. There is nothing threatening, intimidating, harassing, sexual or dangerous-driving related; the exchange is an ordinary pickup-time enquiry and the complaint is a fare grievance. Safety_concern = none, so no escalation is triggered [F7][F8][F10][SAFE-1].

Evidence: the record sets every element this ruling needs — the cancelling party and the cancelled_at/acceptance timestamps [F2], the GPS position report [F1], the arrival-confirmation fields [F3][F4], the fee amount [F5] and the full chat with timestamps [F9]. Nothing material is missing, so evidence_status = sufficient and no escalate. Routing/route-deviation findings are empty because this is a no_show case with no off-route segment, so RD-3/RD-5 do not arise. Flag: the trace reports flag_account required = False, and no RD-6 or NS-2 condition is met (the rider cancelled, and the driver did not tap "I'm Here" from a wrong location) [F2][F4][RD-6][NS-2], so flag_account = false.

events.title: Notices sent to rider and driver
events.body:
RIDER: We looked at your cancellation and the fee stays as charged: $6.61, no refund. You cancelled about 3 minutes and 20 seconds after you matched, which is past our 3-minute window, so the cancellation fee applies. A driver still being on the way doesn't make a cancellation free — Ryde has no "driver later than the estimated arrival" free-cancellation rule. The $6.61 comes off as a Ryde voucher adjustment already recorded on your account; nothing further is deducted. If you'd like a discretionary review, contact RydeHELP within 30 days. Your account isn't flagged.

DRIVER: We reviewed the cancelled trip. No payment is due to you and no charge is made against the rider beyond the $6.61 rider cancellation fee, which stays with the platform. You didn't tap "I'm Here" and were never recorded at the pickup point, so no waiting fee or no-show charge applies. Keep tapping "I'm Here" as soon as you arrive — waiting fees and no-show claims depend on it. No action is needed from you, and your account isn't flagged. If you have questions about this trip, contact RydeHELP.
